text:
emma: Quick follow-up from the token-validation degradation this morning. Want clear owners, short timelines, and a plan to stop repeat occurrences.

emma: Root cause summary: service token rotation fell behind due to a race in the rotation job + gaps in audit event ingestion during a logging pipeline retry window. Two contributing factors: perms drift on the rotation runner and missing ingestion checks.

emma: Proposed remediation tracks:
- rotation resilience (guardian + retries + permissions hardening)
- audit ingestion coverage & backfill playbook
- CI/regression + SLO for token-validation

emma: Initial action items (owners + target date):
- kyle -> rotation guardian exporter + alerting (due 2026-04-08)
- rafael -> audit-backfill script + validation queries (due 2026-04-05)
- security-oncall -> runbook + SLO proposal (due 2026-04-06)

kyle: I'll take the guardian. Plan: small exporter + Prom rule that pages on consecutive rotation failures. Will open PR by EOD tomorrow.

kyle: alert sketch:
```
# prom alert: rotation_fails
expr: increase(service_rotation_failures_total[15m]) > 1
for: 3m
labels:
  severity: page
```

rafael: I'll handle the backfill. Finding the dropped window now, will craft an ES query to recover missing auth events and a validation query to ensure backfill coverage. Need security to confirm fields.

security-oncall: We'll draft the runbook and SLO language. Suggestion: token-validation success >= 99.95% over rolling 7d with page on 99.9% breach. Will post a short justification.

ops-bot: Reminder: remediation sync every Tue 11:00 PT starting 2026-04-07. Auto-reminder will post 1h before.

emma: I created tracker items and linked this thread. Please update tracker and post a one-line closure here when done so we can mark the postmortem remediated.

kyle: PR: https://github.com/redwood/infra/pull/998 - exporter + alert + unit tests. Please review.

kyle: Note: adding a guardian alone isn't enough; I'll also add a small synthetic job that runs rotation in staging and emits an audit event so we test the entire path.

rafael: Backfill draft at https://redwood-internal/issue/4521 with sample events and the ES query. I'll run it in staging first and then request approval from security.

security-oncall: Runbook draft: https://docs.redwood/internal/runbooks/token_validation_followup.md 6 SLO rationale posted. Will add escalation steps and ownership matrix.

emma: Recurrence note: this is the second token rotation + audit-ingestion incident in the last 10 months. Recommend two changes: (1) add token-health SLO to the ops dashboard, (2) add monthly smoke test for the audit pipeline.

kyle: Agreed on monthly smoke test. I'll add a Jenkins job that runs the synthetic rotation + verifies the audit event appears.

rafael: Also adding a one-off verification to backfill to validate idempotency and avoid duplicate downstream processing.

emma: If any ETA shifts, call it out early. Owners, please post a short status update in this thread when you close your item so we can close the loop on the postmortem. Thanks. :white_check_mark:
